games 5-8: your door 1 in 3 (blue), the other two 2 in 3 (orange); hook A' / B'
games 9-20, faster (8ths, then 16ths); the wall of 35 stages builds on 16ths (snare roll); hook B''
rounds 1-16: all 35 stages play a game a beat, the tally pours in; hook C
rounds 17-28 to game 1,000, then bar 19 the winners flash side by side; hook C' up an octave
bar 20 near-empty: the wall folds away row by row; bar 21 the doors close; hook A'' falling
